findings.mitigation: Either (a) land schemas/scp-resource-envelope.schema.json in this slice covering the common {schema_version, key_id, ...payload} envelope shape, plus per-resource payload schemas for each of the 11 URI types; or (b) create an explicitly named tracked-forward item in WP-SCP-021 §4 or §4.1 — e.g., 'JSON Schema for resource envelopes — deferred to 021F alongside adopter guide'. findings.claim: waivers.json is read via two separate git-show subprocess calls within a single _build_snapshot invocation.
findings.evidence: resources.py line 546 (_build_waivers): _read_committed_json(self._repo_root, ref, 'output/findings/waivers.json'). resources.py line 580 (_build_findings): same call with identical arguments. When the HTTP transport (021H) enables concurrent requests with a cache miss on first call, this doubles waiver-file read latency and doubles process-table pressure for that window. Not a correctness issue.
findings.mitigation: Hoist the waivers.json read to _build_snapshot: raw_waivers = _read_committed_json(self._repo_root, ref, 'output/findings/waivers.json'). Pass the parsed list into both _build_waivers(ref=ref, key_id=..., waivers_raw=raw_waivers) and _build_findings(ref=ref, key_id=..., waivers_raw=raw_waivers). Removes one subprocess call per snapshot build.

findings.claim: Redundant current_key is None guard in _parse_signing_keys at resources.py line 248.
findings.evidence: resources.py lines 239-248: current_key is set to None initially; the fallback block (lines 244-246) sets current_key to keys[0] only when 'current_key is None and keys'. Therefore at line 248, if keys is non-empty, current_key is guaranteed non-None; if keys is empty, the list comprehension iterates over an empty sequence regardless. The 'current_key is None' branch in the filter expression on line 248 is unreachable.
findings.impact: Harmless but signals a logic-review shortcut; a future reader may infer that current_key can be None at that point and introduce compensating logic elsewhere.
findings.mitigation: Simplify line 248 to: previous_keys = [e for e in keys if e['key_id'] != current_key['key_id']] if current_key is not None else list(keys). This makes the intent explicit and the guard load-bearing.

structured_review.summary: All 11 distinct URI types across 9 dispatch bullets are implemented and registered. Committed-state invariant, git-SHA cache invalidation, and tool-vs-resource contract are correctly structured. No new tool was added; server.py registration is the only 021B/C touch. Four MAJ gaps prevent a clean pass: (1) scp://status has no dedicated test and its non-trivial parsing paths are never asserted; (2) three open unknowns (U-21-b, U-21-e, U-21-h) required to close before 021D per §13 have no formal closure evidence; (3) no JSON Schema files for resource envelopes, contrary to WP-SCP-021 §9 AC #4; (4) resource-update notification pathway is unexercised.
